mapper.select: SELECT reorg_key, reorg_dt, reorg_title, conf_yn, use_yn FROM hrm_org_reorg ORDER BY reorg_dt DESC, reg_dtm DESC, reorg_key

WITH RECURSIVE snapshot AS ( SELECT dept_key, parent_dept_key, dept_cd, dept_nm, dept_level, sort_order FROM hrm_org_dept WHERE reorg_key = #{reorgKey} AND use_yn = 'Y' ), matches AS ( SELECT * FROM snapshot
AND dept_cd = #{deptCd} AND STRPOS(LOWER(dept_cd), LOWER(#{deptCd})) > 0
AND STRPOS(LOWER(dept_nm), LOWER(#{deptNm})) > 0
), tree AS ( SELECT * FROM matches UNION SELECT parent.* FROM snapshot parent JOIN tree child ON child.parent_dept_key = parent.dept_key ) SELECT tree.dept_key, tree.parent_dept_key, tree.dept_cd, tree.dept_nm, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM matches WHERE matches.dept_key = tree.dept_key) AS matched FROM tree ORDER BY tree.dept_level, tree.sort_order, tree.dept_cd, tree.dept_key
